hook.name: UniClawHookV4
hook.description: Dual-mode Uniswap v4 hook supporting agent-only and public pools. For agent-only pools, swaps and liquidity actions are gated to verified agents via an on-chain registry. After each swap, a configurable fee (optionally scaled by the swapper's on-chain reputation score) is extracted from the output token and accumulated for the pool creator to collect.
